page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.16xlarge is a compute-optimized arm64 instance powered by the proprietary Alibaba Yitian 710 processor operating at 2.75 GHz. It features 64 dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading (1 thread per core), coupled with 128 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio. The processor architecture includes 64 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 64 MB L3 cache. Hardware-accelerated AES cryptography instructions are present, while x86-specific vector extensions are absent.

Multi-threaded benchmark testing reflects strong parallel processing scaling, achieving a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 114,685.05 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression throughput of 486.63 GB/sec, placing it in the top 25% of evaluated cloud instances. Memory performance is highlighted by a PassMark memory score of 3,017.93 in the top 10% tier and cached read bandwidth reaching 6,476.63 GB/sec. Uncached memory throughput measures 128.75 GB/sec for large block reads and 64.46 GB/sec for writes. The platform delivers strong concurrency for memory-bound applications, reaching 94.6 million Redis SET operations per second. Single-core performance and LLM inference speeds remain in the average tier across benchmarks.

The instance does not bundle local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The custom arm64 Yitian architecture offers high core density and execution efficiency for parallelized software, offering cost efficiency for high-concurrency microservices, multi-threaded data processing, in-memory caching, and batch processing pipelines compiled for ARM architecture.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance based on the 64-core Alibaba Yitian 710 arm64 processor running at 2.75 GHz. It features 64 physical cores with a single thread per core and dedicated CPU allocation, combined with 128 GB of system memory for a 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio. Built without local disk storage, the instance relies on network storage and provides a baseline network throughput of 32 Gbps. In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong multi-threaded performance, high cached memory bandwidth, and high throughput in memory-bound applications, reaching 94.6 million Redis SET operations per second and strong PassMark database scores. However, single-core processing and LLM text generation fall into average benchmark tiers. The instance delivers high resource density and throughput efficiency for multi-threaded ARM workloads, parallel data processing, in-memory key-value stores, and compiled microservices.
